items.statement: Bounded inference about test whether preferential association and a metal-related dark/charge-transfer state are distinguishable explanations for HL response to Fe(III), using a source competing ion and balanced solution species.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
